description: Insert a budget decision gateway with explicit approve and reject branches before request approval.

operations.xml: <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="GW-P2P-BUDGET" name="Budget available?" default="FLOW-P2P-004B"/><bpmn:sequenceFlow id="FLOW-P2P-004A" name="Budget approved" sourceRef="GW-P2P-BUDGET" targetRef="GW-P2P-APPROVED"><bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">budgetAvailable = true</bpmn:conditionExpression></bpmn:sequenceFlow><bpmn:sequenceFlow id="FLOW-P2P-004B" name="Budget unavailable" sourceRef="GW-P2P-BUDGET" targetRef="P2P-END-REJECTED"/>
